title: In-silico and in-vitro investigation of STAT3-PIM1 heterodimeric complex: Its mechanism and inhibition by curcumin for cancer therapeutics.
authors: Mahata, Sutapa; Behera, Santosh Kumar; Kumar, Sunil; Sahoo, Pranab Kumar; Sarkar, Sinjini; Fazil, Mobashar Hussain Urf Turabe; Nasare, Vilas D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究STAT3-PIM1蛋白-蛋白异二聚体及姜黄素抑制机制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系中的STAT3但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作，非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: The functional activity among STAT3 and PIM1, are key signaling events for cancer cell function. Curcumin, a diarylheptanoid isolated from turmeric, effectively inhibits STAT3 signaling. Selectively, we attempted to address interactions of STAT3, PIM1 and Curcumin for therapeutic intervention using in silico and in vitro experimental approaches. Firstly, protein-protein interactions (PPI) between STAT3-PIM1 by molecular docking studies reflected salt bridges among Arg279 (STAT3)-Glu140 (PIM1) and Arg282 (STAT3)-Asp100 (PIM1), with a binding affinity of -38.6 kcal/mol. Secondly, molecular dynamics simulations of heterodimeric STAT3-PIM1 complex with curcumin revealed binding of curcumin on PIM-1 interface of the complex through hydrogen bonds (Asp155) and hydrophobic interactions (Leu13, Phe18, Val21, etc.) with a binding energy of -7.3 kcal/mol. These PPIs were confirmed in vitro by immunoprecipitation assays in MDA-MB-231 cells. Corroborating our results, expression levels of STAT3 and PIM1 decreased after curcumin treatment. We observed that PIM1 interacts with STAT3 and these functional interactions are disrupted by curcumin. The calculated band energy gap of heterodimeric STAT3-PIM1-Curcumin complex was of 9.621 kcal/mol. The present study revealed the role of curcumin in STAT3/PIM1 signaling and its binding affinity to the complex for design of advanced cancer therapeutics.
abstract_zh: STAT3与PIM1之间的功能活性是癌细胞功能的关键信号事件。姜黄素（curcumin）是一种从姜黄中分离出的二芳基庚烷类化合物，能有效抑制STAT3信号传导。我们选择性地尝试通过计算机模拟（in silico）和体外（in vitro）实验方法，探讨STAT3、PIM1与姜黄素之间的相互作用，以用于治疗干预。首先，通过分子对接（molecular docking）研究STAT3-PIM1之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI），反映了Arg279 (STAT3)-Glu140 (PIM1)和Arg282 (STAT3)-Asp100 (PIM1)之间的盐桥，结合亲和力为-38.6 kcal/mol。其次，对异二聚体STAT3-PIM1复合物与姜黄素的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示，姜黄素通过氢键（Asp155）和疏水相互作用（Leu13、Phe18、Val21等）结合在复合物的PIM-1界面上，结合能为-7.3 kcal/mol。这些PPI在MDA-MB-231细胞中通过免疫沉淀（immunoprecipitation）实验在体外得到证实。与我们的结果一致，姜黄素处理后STAT3和PIM1的表达水平下降。我们观察到PIM1与STAT3相互作用，而这些功能性相互作用被姜黄素破坏。异二聚体STAT3-PIM1-姜黄素复合物的计算带隙能量为9.621 kcal/mol。本研究揭示了姜黄素在STAT3/PIM1信号传导中的作用及其对复合物的结合亲和力，为设计先进癌症治疗策略提供了依据。
